text:
v1.0.49 is published and the release slot is free for the other session:
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.49
It holds the Kalshi ticker fix (bets from the engine's list), the Arb note showing the engine's full check, and the phone no longer scanning Kalshi itself while the engine is starting up.
